title: Standard Definition
description: Schema for standard/regulation metadata. Each standard is defined once and referenced by ID across the catalog.

id.description: Unique identifier used to reference this standard (e.g., NIST-SP-800-53).

local_copy.description: Repo-relative path to a local copy of the source document (e.g., sources/nasa/npr-2810-7.pdf). Optional — captured for clean-room provenance.

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of local_copy. Allows verifying that a downloaded source matches the version this catalog was decomposed from.

date_accessed.description: Date the local_copy was downloaded from url. Important for sources that may change without versioning.

supersedes.description: ID of the standard this one supersedes.

status.description: Current status. "stub" indicates a placeholder entry referenced by other standards but not yet fully reviewed (no local_copy, sha256, authority graph, or annotations). See docs/curation-policy.md.

tier.description: Hierarchy level for authority graph layout. 0=Constitution, 1=Statute, 2=Executive Order, 3=OMB Policy, 4=Federal Regulation, 5=FIPS, 6=NIST SP/NARA, 7=Agency Policy, 8=Agency Procedure, 9=Handbook.

authority.description: Authority relationships to other standards in the graph.

derives_from.description: Vertical authority chain — where this standard gets its legal authority.

id.description: ID of the parent authority standard.

section.description: Specific section of the parent standard.

references.description: Lateral cross-references — related but not authority-granting.
